flags.$comment: analytics stays false until the Worker is deployed and Web Analytics is on; the privacy page hides its analytics section while this is false.

beacon.$comment: Endpoint for anonymous event batches. Enable only after deploying workers/beacon and adding the /api/e route.

verify.note: Search engine verification. Tokens are emitted as meta tags at build time; leave empty to skip. Keep the Google token: it is what keeps Search Console verified for this domain.
